reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited text supports it: 14.1 confirms Customer ownership of Customer Data, Customer Confidential Information and independently developed IP with only a limited processing right to Vendor; 14.2 contains a present assignment of Deliverables plus personnel assignments and further assurances; 14.3 limits Vendor to pre-existing Vendor Technology and routes embedded Vendor Technology to the Section 13.2 perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence including modification and derivative works; 14.4 negates joint ownership and keeps feedback rights narrow.

Definitions do not undercut the position: 'Vendor Technology' (1.8) excludes Customer Data and Customer's pre-Effective Date IP, and 'Customer Data' (1.3) covers submitted material and derived output, with only non-attributable telemetry carved out; 15.1 additionally bars sale, advertising use, cross-customer combination and model training without consent.

No redline or counterparty comment is expected for a compliant finding, and none was proposed; the deterministic check (no residual assignment of Customer IP/data to Vendor) passes and the rendered text is unchanged.
The payment condition in 14.2 and the 'improve the Services' processing purpose in 14.1 are market-standard qualifiers, correctly characterized as not walk-away issues rather than being overstated.
